grammar.key: Present Perfect Tense (has/have + past participle) / 现在完成时 (has/have + 过去分词)
grammar.title: Present Perfect Tense (has/have + past participle) / 现在完成时 (has/have + 过去分词)
grammar.titleEn: Present Perfect Tense (has/have + past participle) / 现在完成时 (has/have + 过去分词)
grammar.usage:
English: The Present Perfect Tense is formed with has/have + past participle (e.g., taken, lived). It is used here for two reasons: 1) To describe an action (taking place) that happened at an unspecified time in the past but has a result or relevance to the present (the towns are now different). 2) To describe an action (lived) that started in the past and continues up to the present (for centuries).
中文: 现在完成时 由 has/have + 过去分词 构成（例如：taken, lived）。这里使用它有两个原因：1) 描述一个在过去不明确时间发生但结果或影响持续到现在的动作（发生了改变）。2) 描述一个从过去开始并持续到现在的动作（居住了几个世纪）。
notes:
English: A common trap is confusing Present Perfect with Simple Past. Remember: Present Perfect often connects past and present, and is used with time expressions like 'for', 'since', 'already', 'yet', 'ever', 'never'. Simple Past is for finished actions at a specific past time.
中文: 一个常见的陷阱是混淆现在完成时和一般过去时。记住：现在完成时连接过去和现在，常与 'for', 'since', 'already', 'yet', 'ever', 'never' 等时间状语连用。一般过去时用于发生在过去特定时间的已完成的动作。

grammar.titleEn: Passive Voice (Present Simple) / 被动语态 (一般现在时)
grammar.usage:
English: This sentence uses the Present Continuous Passive Voice: am/is/are + being + past participle. The Passive Voice is used when the focus is on the action or the object (new cities) rather than who is doing the action (the builders). We don't know or don't need to say who is building them. The 'being' shows the action is in progress now.
中文: 这个句子使用了现在进行时的被动语态：am/is/are + being + 过去分词。当强调动作或宾语（新城市）而不是动作执行者（建造者）时，使用被动语态。我们不知道或不需要说出谁在建它们。'being' 表示动作现在正在进行。
notes:
English: A common exam task is to change an active sentence into a passive one, or vice versa. Remember the formula: Object + be + past participle (+ by + agent). Pay attention to the tense of 'be' verb (am, is, are, was, were, etc.).
中文: 常见的考试题目是将主动句改为被动句，或反之。记住公式：宾语 + be动词 + 过去分词 (+ by + 执行者)。注意 'be' 动词的时态 (am, is, are, was, were 等)。

English: Distinguish between 'will' for predictions (like here) and 'will' for instant decisions or promises. Also, don't confuse 'will' with 'be going to'. grammar.title: Gerund as Subject / 动名词作主语
grammar.titleEn: Gerund as Subject / 动名词作主语
grammar.usage:
English: A gerund is a verb form ending in -ing that functions as a noun. Here, the gerund phrase 'Doing housework' acts as the subject of the sentence. It is the thing that 'is good'. Using a gerund as a subject is a common way to talk about activities or concepts in a general sense.
中文: 动名词 是动词的 -ing 形式，起名词作用。在这里，动名词短语 'Doing housework' 充当句子的主语。它是'有好处'的那个事物。用动名词作主语是谈论一般意义上的活动或概念的常见方式。
notes:
English: Remember that when a gerund is the subject, the verb that follows must be singular (e.g., 'is', 'was', 'helps'). A common mistake is using a plural verb. Also, don't confuse gerunds (used as nouns) with present participles in continuous tenses (used with 'be' to form verbs).
中文: 记住当动名词作主语时，后面的动词必须是单数形式（例如：'is', 'was', 'helps'）。一个常见的错误是使用复数动词。同时，不要混淆动名词（用作名词）和进行时态中的现在分词（与 'be' 连用构成动词）。

grammar.title: First Conditional (If-clause) / 第一条件句 (If 从句)
grammar.titleEn: First Conditional (If-clause) / 第一条件句 (If 从句)
grammar.usage:
This is a First Conditional sentence. It talks about a real and possible situation in the present or future and its likely result.
这是一个 第一条件句。它谈论的是现在或将来一个真实且可能的情况及其可能的结果。
Structure: If + Present Simple/Present Continuous, ... will/can/modal verb + base verb OR Present Tense (for general truths/habits). Here, it uses Present Continuous in the 'if' clause and Present Continuous in the main clause to describe a current, ongoing situation and its concurrent result.
结构： If + 一般现在时/现在进行时, ... will/can/情态动词 + 动词原形 或 现在时态（表示普遍真理/习惯）。这里，'if' 从句使用现在进行时，主句也使用现在进行时，来描述一个当前正在进行的情况及其同时发生的结果。
forms: Structure: If + Present Simple/Present Continuous, ... will/can/modal verb + base verb OR Present Tense (for general truths/habits). Here, it uses Present Continuous in the 'if' clause and Present Continuous in the main clause to describe a current, ongoing situation and its concurrent result.
结构： If + 一般现在时/现在进行时, ... will/can/情态动词 + 动词原形 或 现在时态（表示普遍真理/习惯）。这里，'if' 从句使用现在进行时，主句也使用现在进行时，来描述一个当前正在进行的情况及其同时发生的结果。
notes:
Trap: Don't use 'will' in the 'if' clause when talking about future possibilities. Use present tense. The 'will' (or other future form) goes in the main clause. Also, note that the main clause can use present tense for habitual actions, as in this example.
陷阱： 在谈论未来可能性时，不要在 'if' 从句中使用 'will'。使用现在时态。'will'（或其他将来形式）用在主句中。另外注意，主句可以使用现在时态表示习惯性动作，如本例所示。

grammar.usage:
This sentence uses the Present Perfect Tense. It is formed with have/has + past participle. This tense is used here for two key reasons: 1) To describe an action (changes taking place) that happened at an unspecified time in the past but has a result or relevance in the present (the towns are now different). 2) To describe an action (living in towns) that started in the past and continues up to the present (for centuries).
这个句子使用了现在完成时。它由 have/has + 过去分词构成。这里使用这个时态有两个关键原因：1) 描述一个发生在过去不确定时间但结果或影响持续到现在的动作（发生变化）。2) 描述一个从过去开始并持续到现在的动作（居住在城镇）。
Structure: Subject + have/has + past participle (e.g., have taken, have lived).
结构： 主语 + have/has + 过去分词 (例如：have taken, have lived)。
forms: Structure: Subject + have/has + past participle (e.g., have taken, have lived).
结构： 主语 + have/has + 过去分词 (例如：have taken, have lived)。
notes:
Trap: Do not use Present Perfect with specific past time expressions like 'yesterday', 'last year', 'in 1990'. Use Past Simple instead. Present Perfect often uses unspecific time words like 'already', 'yet', 'ever', 'never', 'recently', 'for + period of time', 'since + point in time'.
陷阱： 不要将现在完成时与具体的过去时间状语如 'yesterday', 'last year', 'in 1990' 连用。应使用一般过去时。现在完成时常与不具体的时间词连用，如 'already', 'yet', 'ever', 'never', 'recently', 'for + 时间段', 'since + 时间点'。

grammar.title: Passive Voice (Present Continuous) / 被动语态 (现在进行时)
grammar.titleEn: Passive Voice (Present Continuous) / 被动语态 (现在进行时)
grammar.usage:
This sentence is in the Present Continuous Passive voice. The Passive Voice is used when the focus is on the action or the object receiving the action, not on who or what is performing the action (the agent). Here, the focus is on 'new cities' and the action of 'building' that is happening to them now.
这个句子是现在进行时的被动语态。当重点在于动作或接受动作的对象，而不在于执行动作的人或物（施动者）时，使用被动语态。这里的重点是 'new cities' 以及现在正在对它们进行的 'building' 这个动作。
Structure: Subject (receiver) + am/is/are + being + past participle (of the main verb).
结构： 主语（接受者）+ am/is/are + being + 主要动词的过去分词。
forms: Structure: Subject (receiver) + am/is/are + being + past participle (of the main verb).
结构： 主语（接受者）+ am/is/are + being + 主要动词的过去分词。
notes:
Trick: To identify passive voice, look for the structure 'be + past participle'. If you see 'being' between 'be' and the past participle, it's often a continuous passive (e.g., is being built, are being discussed). Remember that in passive sentences, the agent (the doer) can be introduced with 'by', but it is often omitted if it's unknown or unimportant.
诀窍： 要识别被动语态，寻找结构 'be + 过去分词'。如果你在 'be' 和过去分词之间看到 'being'，这通常是一个进行时的被动语态（例如，is being built, are being discussed）。记住，在被动句中，施动者（执行者）可以用 'by' 引出，但如果未知或不重要，则经常被省略。

exercises.explain: The subject is the thing that is receiving the action of 'building'. / 主语是接受 'building' 这个动作的事物。

exercises.q: What part of the verb structure indicates the continuous aspect? / 动词结构的哪一部分表示进行体？
exercises.explain: 'Being' is used between the form of 'be' (are) and the past participle to show the action is in progress. / 'Being' 用在 'be' 的形式 (are) 和过去分词之间，表示动作正在进行。

exercises.q: Is the sentence focusing on who is building the cities or on the fact that cities are under construction? / 这个句子是侧重于谁在建城市，还是侧重于城市正在建设这一事实？

exercises.q: Which sentence is in the passive voice? / 哪个句子是被动语态？

A delicious meal was cooked by the chef.
The chef is cooking a meal.
exercises.answer: A delicious meal was cooked by the chef.
